items.why: Pivotal raised its price target to $930 from $790 with a Buy rating, citing strong early adoption of the Muse assistant and the Muse Wonder model launch.
Apple is rallying toward a 345.34 buy point, with BofA noting shorter iPhone 18 Pro wait times as Duo pre-order shipments loom.
Chip stocks slid after Broadcom's boss likened AI investing to a casino, sparking a broad selloff in AI and memory chip names.
Microsoft is on pace for a record high after reclaiming a $4 trillion market cap on Monday, and Barclays raised its price target to $600 from $512.

market_note: Bank earnings are on deck: Goldman beat expectations while JPMorgan missed.
summary: A mixed tape: chip and AI names are dragging the Nasdaq lower on AI spending jitters, while Meta, Apple, and Microsoft lead the gainers on analyst optimism.
